name: HR Specialist
description: Administers core HR operations across the Human Resources & Talent value stream, spanning employee relations case management, leave administration, and open enrollment. Configures benefits and compensation systems in the HRIS, updates salary bands, validates manager compensation recommendations, and implements process controls under HR policy governance to prevent pay-equity gaps.

name: Head of Broker Distribution
description: Leads broker channel strategy and operations within Sales, Distribution & Marketing, owning distribution operating-model design and agency broker relationship governance. Oversees producer compliance records, agreement delivery, and termination governance, ingests and validates MGA bordereaux, and drives renewal retention, producer training, and digital channel performance through the CRM.

name: Head of Capital Management
description: Owns capital planning and deployment within Finance & Investments, leading long-range planning, dividend management, and unclaimed property compliance filings with state regulators. Oversees expense policy governance, cost reduction programs, and reinsurance accounting, rebalancing budgets to target capital returns and facilitating strategic planning on growth targets through the ERP and general ledger.

name: Head of Compliance
description: Leads the compliance function across Risk, Compliance & Audit, owning compliance issue response, regulatory change management, and market conduct risk assessment. Triages and investigates compliance issues, escalates major findings to the CCO, tracks examination corrective actions, and oversees third-party and cyber risk monitoring, maintaining KRI quality and the operational risk register in the GRC platform.

name: Head of Distribution
description: Leads enterprise distribution strategy across Sales, Distribution & Marketing, owning agency broker relationship governance, distribution operating-model design, and delegated authority oversight. Monitors producer conduct investigations and corrective actions, supports producer pipeline and training programs, enforces marketing governance standards, and tracks bound submissions and forecasts in the CRM.

name: Head of IT
description: Leads Technology & Engineering, owning the technology roadmap, enterprise architecture governance, and modernization planning. Sets architecture standards and platform guardrails, directs solution architecture and technology vendor evaluations including stability and security reviews, and manages the technology lifecycle and obsolescence roadmap while promoting reusable services.

name: Head of Pricing
description: Leads pricing across the Actuarial value stream, owning rate filings, rate indication analysis, and predictive rating model development on actuarial modeling platforms. Calibrates underwriting guidelines with quantified financial impact, prices reinsurance treaties including excess and catastrophe layers, and governs assumption refreshes and portfolio performance monitoring.

name: Head of Reinsurance
description: Leads the Reinsurance value stream, owning retrocession structuring, net-retention setting, and annual reinsurance strategy and appetite approval. Chairs the reinsurance governance committee, coordinates regulatory reporting and reviews with compliance and audit, oversees assumed contract wording and exposure data ingestion, and manages recovery billing to reinsurers.

name: IAM Engineer
description: Administers identity and access management within Cybersecurity & IAM, owning identity lifecycle management, directory services, and single sign-on onboarding for applications. Manages federation trusts and attribute mappings on the IAM platform, runs access certifications and privileged account onboarding, governs service accounts, and monitors MFA anomalies and privileged activity audits.

name: IP Counsel
description: Provides intellectual property and commercial legal counsel within Legal & Corporate Governance, supporting board meeting planning, secretarial filings, and legal entity administration. Manages regulatory filings and DOI objection responses, oversees contract financial obligations and vendor data processing governance, and coordinates e-discovery readiness and dispute or arbitration proceedings.

name: ISO Architect
description: Designs and enforces security architecture across Cybersecurity & IAM, owning data security management, container security, and security hardening standards. Manages enterprise key management and encryption lifecycles, deploys and tunes web application firewalls with SIEM integration, prioritizes vulnerability risk, and coordinates emergency patching for exploited vulnerabilities.

name: IT Security Manager
description: Oversees security operations within Cybersecurity & IAM, owning vulnerability risk prioritization, patch remediation tracking, and security hardening management. Governs data security controls, privileged activity auditing, and privileged account onboarding, verifies container image signing before production deployment, and closes audit-trail and log coverage gaps against GRC requirements.

name: IT Service Delivery Manager
description: Coordinates AIOps-driven service delivery within the Data & AI value stream, owning runbook automation, auto-remediation, and AIOps model governance. Oversees event correlation, ML-based anomaly detection, and service topology mapping, reviews automation effectiveness quarterly, verifies permanent fixes reduce incident recurrence, and reports continuous-improvement gains.
